observations: Photo 0 shows a bare car engine assembly on the ground (no car body attached).
There is a visible intake/airbox area and a large engine cover/upper housing with hoses and wiring harnesses.
No readable brand/model markings are visible in the photo (no engine code/plate/label clearly legible).
No clear evidence of mileage, service history, compression test, or whether it runs.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any import/tokumbo proof (documents, markings, or identifiable engine code).

risks.risk: Engine model/compatibility is unknown; wrong engine for the buyer’s vehicle would make it unusable.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine identification plate/engine code (or VIN/engine number stamping) plus the vehicle make/model it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown used engine (worst-case: may not fit or may require additional parts).

risks.risk: Unknown running condition (could be dead, seized, or have internal damage).
risks.proof: Video clip of the engine cranking/running (or a mechanic’s test report showing compression/leak-down).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst-case: treated as not working).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (alternator, starter, sensors, mounts, hoses) may not be included.
risks.proof: Photo of the full engine from multiple angles showing all ports/connectors, and a checklist of included accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: assume missing some accessories).

risks.risk: Potential oil/water leaks or damaged wiring/harnesses not visible from this single overhead shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of common leak points (oil pan area, valve cover edges, coolant hoses/thermostat housing) and harness connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may need repairs (worst-case: assume leaks/damage requiring replacement).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the engine code/plate (engine number) and any visible brand/model markings.
Send a video of the engine cranking and running (or a compression test result from a mechanic).
Confirm the exact vehicle make/model/year it came from (and show the engine code matching it).
Send photos showing all accessories included (starter, alternator, sensors, ECU if applicable, mounts) and any missing items.
response.reason: From the photo, the engine type/model and working condition cannot be confirmed, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the engine code and proof it runs or test results.
